domain.match: Match each Egyptian god to what they ruled over.

rows.label: Osiris
rows.description: god of the afterlife in Egyptian mythology
rows.hook: was killed and dismembered by his brother, then put back together by his devoted wife

rows.label: Anubis
rows.description: Egyptian deity of mummification and the afterlife, usually depicted as a man with a canine head
rows.hook: is pictured with a jackal head and watched over mummies and tombs

rows.label: Ra
rows.hook: sailed across the heavens each day in a boat, ruling as king of the gods

rows.label: Isis
rows.hook: revived her slain husband and raised their falcon-headed son in hiding

rows.label: Horus
rows.hook: is shown with a falcon head and fought his uncle for the throne of Egypt

rows.label: Seth
rows.description: God of the desert, storms, and foreigners in ancient Egyptian religion
rows.hook: killed his own brother and was the rival of the falcon-headed sky god

rows.label: Bastet
rows.domain: cats and the protection of the home
rows.hook: is shown as a cat, or a woman with a cat head, and guarded homes

rows.label: Hathor
rows.description: major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion
rows.hook: is shown with cow horns holding a sun disk, and was the divine patron of dance and song

rows.label: Apophis
rows.description: snake god in ancient Egyptian religion

rows.label: Nephthys
rows.domain: mourning and the protection of the dead

rows.label: Nut
rows.description: goddess of the sky in the Ennead of Egyptian mythology
